preRegisteredFalsifiers.note: Stated BEFORE running each violation, per the 2026-08-21 enforcement rule that a planner's own checks get the same pre-registration as a lane's. Each names the result that would prove the assertion is not a check.
preRegisteredFalsifiers.A: Removing the WhatYouCanDo mount from ClaudeSetupPanel MUST fail the presence and ordering tests. If they pass, the assertions are not reading the setup state at all.
preRegisteredFalsifiers.B: Moving the disclosure ABOVE the numbered steps MUST fail ONLY the ordering test. If the presence tests also fail, the ordering test is not independent. If NOTHING fails, the ordering assertion is decorative.
preRegisteredFalsifiers.C: Flipping useState(false) to useState(true) MUST fail the collapsed assertion. If it passes, collapsed is unmeasured.
preRegisteredFalsifiers.D: Promoting the toggle to variant=primary MUST fail the lead-action assertion. If it passes, primaryActions() is vacuous.

unexpectedFindingInvestigated.observation: The FULL property-explorer suite (what CI actually runs, pnpm --filter property-explorer test) fails TWO files locally, not the one the dispatch named: src/lib/pe-llms-txt.test.ts AND scripts/render-mark.test.mjs (SyntaxError at collection, no tests run).
unexpectedFindingInvestigated.mechanism1: Windows-checkout CRLF artifact in a file this lane does not touch. EVIDENCE, not inference: (a) git status shows apps/property-explorer/scripts/ entirely unmodified, so the file vitest chokes on is byte-for-byte HEAD; (b) the full suite was re-run against a PRISTINE tree (both my files git-checkout'd back to HEAD, git status --porcelain empty) and produced the identical 2-failed/156-passed file split; (c) gh run list --workflow=property-explorer-ci.yml returns conclusion STRING success on the last five runs of the same suite on Linux; (d) origin/fix/pe-windows-test-suites is a one-commit branch adding .gitattributes, titled 'pin line endings so the two Windows-only test failures stop being pre-existing' — it names TWO, and these are the two.
unexpectedFindingInvestigated.mechanism2rejected: A defect introduced by this diff. Rejected on (a) and (b) above: the pristine-tree run reproduces it with zero of my changes on disk. Also rejected: a vitest config problem, since (c) shows the same command green on CI with the same config.
unexpectedFindingInvestigated.action: Reported, not fixed. render-mark.test.mjs is outside this lane's scope and is already owned by origin/fix/pe-windows-test-suites. The dispatch named only pe-llms-txt as the known Windows failure; the second one is flagged so the planner knows the local full-suite baseline is 2 failing files, not 1.
